create_D2vImageConfig: create a D2vImageConfig dataclass to configure image modality with input size, patch size, and embedding dimensions
build_ImageEncoder: build an ImageEncoder instance with a D2vImageConfig, embedding dimension, block factory, and normalization layer
patchify_images: run the ImageEncoder patchify method to convert batched images into flattened patch sequences
unpatchify_patches: run the ImageEncoder unpatchify method to reconstruct batched images from flattened patch sequences
compute_image_mask: run the ImageEncoder compute_mask method to generate 2D block masks for masked image modeling
